title: How Much Distribution Shift Can a Clustering Withstand? Exact Split and Merge Certificates for Structured Transports
abstract: arXiv:2611.22000v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In clustering, the distribution of the population being clustered is often uncertain or changes over time, so the true distribution may shift away from the nominal distribution used to form the clustering. Once the clustering is committed and each member is assigned to a cluster, such shifts may change the distribution of each cluster. They can make a cluster too spread out for one representative at a given resolution, motivating a split, or bring distinct clusters close enough to share a representative at that resolution, motivating a merge. We make these split and merge events precise using a local stability criterion built on the phase-transition analysis in deterministic annealing. This notion of stability enables us to quantify how robust a clustering is against such events. translated_title: 聚类能承受多大的分布偏移？结构化传输下的精确分裂与合并证书
translated_abstract: 在聚类中，被聚类群体的分布往往是不确定的或会随时间变化，因此真实分布可能偏离用于形成聚类的名义分布。一旦聚类被确定并且每个成员被分配到某个簇，这种偏移可能会改变每个簇的分布。这些偏移可能使某个簇在给定分辨率下过于分散而无法由单个代表点表示，从而引发分裂；也可能使不同的簇在该分辨率下足够接近以致可以共享一个代表点，从而引发合并。我们利用建立在确定性退火相变分析之上的局部稳定性准则，对分裂和合并事件进行了精确刻画。这种稳定性概念使我们能够量化聚类对此类事件的鲁棒性。此外，受不确定性和群体变化具有结构化特征的应用场景启发，我们研究位移被限制在预定（空间内）的偏移……
tldr: 该论文基于确定性退火的相变分析提出局部稳定性准则，为聚类在结构化分布偏移下的分裂与合并事件给出精确证书，从而量化聚类对分布偏移的鲁棒性。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a local stability criterion based on phase-transition analysis in deterministic annealing, providing exact split and merge certificates that quantify how robust a clustering is against structured distribution shifts.
